data.rationale: The proposal gets the core flow right (choose city, open the event, set the ticket count, pick the ticket option, Reserve Now), but it never names the Special Events & Experiences section, mixes in venue/restaurant and party-size booking, and lists redundant or unclear steps and extra parameters (time slot, tier), so an automation would need guesswork to get to the event.
